Assignment: Identify the top 5 most populous cities in the world as of late 2023.

Findings: I researched the most recent United Nations data available as of November 2023, specifically the "World Urbanization Prospects 2018" revision. According to this dataset, the rankings for urban agglomerations in 2023 are as follows:
1. Tokyo (approx. 37.2 million)
2. Delhi (approx. 32.9 million)
3. Shanghai
